assignments.resolution: platform-supplied permission set; absent from repository

isolation.annotationSeeAllDataTrue: honor annotation; expose only supplied baseline business data plus setup/metadata according to platform semantics

security.qualification: Explicit local personas, not Salesforce standard-profile defaults or an org export.
security.composition: schemaCapabilities AND (profileGrant OR assignedPermissionSetGrant OR calculatedPermissionSetGroupGrant)
security.falsePermissionMeaning: absence-of-grant; another assigned permission set may grant it

schemaCaps.unknownField: invalid schema reference, not an invented field
schemaCaps.permissionableField: requires matching field grant and object operation grant
schemaCaps.nonPermissionableField: schema-defined access follows corresponding object permission; never infer this classification from a test

profilePolicies.label: Local administrator
profilePolicies.constraints: All grants remain capped by schema read/write capabilities; no write to Id/audit/formula/autonumber fields.

security.permissionSets: Parse actual XML objectPermissions/fieldPermissions/userPermissions/classAccesses; same model handles DML-created ObjectPermissions and FieldPermissions.
security.permissionSetGroups: Union declared members after explicit recalculation; preserve declared status and invalidation on membership changes.
security.runAs: Resolve user by Id, apply ProfileId/assignments, restore previous context on all exits; do not enforce CRUD/FLS for ordinary system-mode Apex merely because runAs is active.
security.recordSharing: Separate row visibility from CRUD/FLS; use schema sharingModel/owner/viewAll/modifyAll. Unknown sharing semantics stay blocked.
security.userMode: Enforce object, field and row access for explicit USER_MODE query/DML.
security.stripInaccessible: Compute removed fields and record projection from effective access, retaining source records unchanged; root-object access failure must follow explicit API option.
